'''Klallor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who lived on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Klallor worked in a butcher's shop in [[Gadrin]] called ''[[Fresh Kill]]'' with his brothers [[Gordok]] and [[Vressag]]. He had a violent personality.
